artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior scene with a central figure surrounded by others. The image shows a grand architectural interior with tall columns, arches, and drapery. The central figure is seated on a throne on an elevated platform, with a halo-like aura behind their head. Various figures are gathered around, some sitting and some standing, gesturing towards the central figure. The setting resembles a grand hall or assembly area, conveying importance or authority. The drawing suggests a narrative scene, possibly representing an event or moment of deliberation. The style is classical or neo-classical, emphasizing the symmetry and grandeur of the architecture.

artworks.title: Fisher of Men
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime setting with a high horizon line. In the foreground, people are gathered near a figure on a boat. More individuals are gathered along the shore, and ships and a coastal town are visible in the distance. The artwork features detailed etching lines and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Jesus with the Pharisees
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with people in the foreground and a village surrounded by hills and trees in the background. A group of people is conversing on the left, while others work in wheat fields further away. The scene is depicted in detailed etching style, using fine lines to create texture and depth in the fields and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown and black on cream-colored paper. Cross-hatching is used to create shadows and textures in the image. Trees frame the scene with their branches, directing the viewer's focus towards the central area.

artworks.title: Sermon on the Mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals surrounding a seated figure. The landscape in the drawing features rolling hills and sparse foliage. The individuals are seated at the base of the hills, with one figure sitting on an elevated spot and gesturing. This figure is emitting light with rays extending from their head. A large tree on the right-hand side frames the landscape, and the figures all have rounded halos. The artwork showcases intricate details in the textures of the drapery, foliage, and natural landscape, suggesting careful composition.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals gathered around a central figure who is interacting with the ground. The setting includes large columns creating depth and perspective. The figures are dressed in robes and cloaks, and the scene has a historical or classical feel. In the foreground, people are gathered observing or discussing an event. The drawing features detailed line work emphasizing folds of garments, columns, and architectural elements. The scene appears dynamic with gesturing figures creating movement and tension.

artworks.title: Stoning of Jesus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with multiple figures in an encounter. The drawing shows a large, classical architectural space with grand columns and vaulted arches. Within this structure, figures are interacting energetically, suggesting movement. They are dressed in long robes and some appear to be gesturing or throwing small objects. The scene is dynamic and tense, with figures arranged to guide the viewer's eye. The drawing features detailed line work capturing the architecture and expressive postures of the figures.

artworks.title: Raising of Lazarus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering in a cave-like setting, featuring numerous figures clad in long robes. The scene includes a central prone figure on a makeshift platform, surrounded by individuals with animated gestures. The cave's textured ceiling and rocky formations frame the gathering. The use of line work, shading, and cross-hatching enhances depth and volume in the figures and environment.

artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession in a historical or religious setting. The scene includes a crowd of figures along a path with palm trees. At the center, a figure is seated on a donkey or small horse, surrounded by others walking alongside and in front. The background features towers and arches, suggesting an ancient city. Some figures are kneeling or holding branches. The drawing emphasizes detailed line work and shading to convey depth and movement.

artworks.title: Caesar's Coin
artworks.dimensions: plate (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 8.4 cm (2 3/4 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a city square with architectural elements. The scene features a group of individuals gathered around a central area under an architectural structure with a tall column and arched walls. The figures are dressed in long robes and head coverings. In the background, other figures are engaged in various activities. The architecture has intricate stone detailing, including columns and archways. A gated arch is visible in the distance, adding depth to the scene. The drawing captures a sense of community and social interaction within an urban environment of a past period.

artworks.title: Conversion of Paul
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Ronald Lubritz
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a battle scene in front of a fortified city. The image includes numerous figures on horseback and on foot, carrying spears, shields, and banners. The city with its towering walls and buildings is depicted on the left side. The sky above the city is illustrated with clouds parting to reveal rays of light shining down. The drawing is detailed with precise line work capturing the energy and chaos of the scene.

artworks.title: The Bald Eagle (Falco leucocephalus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an eagle capturing a fish. The artwork depicts an eagle with outstretched wings, capturing a fish with its talons as it descends. The details of the feathers and claws are depicted with precision. In the upper left corner is a smaller sketch of the eagle in flight, and on the right is an outline sketch of an eagle’s head. The background is minimal, emphasizing the interaction between the eagle and its prey. The rendering reflects a study of the bird's anatomy and pose.

artworks.title: David with the Head of Goliath
artworks.medium: monotype printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a detailed drawing with a central figure holding a large head, possibly decapitated, with eyes closed and overgrown hair and beard. The central figure's upper body is visible, with its head turned to the right, featuring softly rendered facial features and adorned with curly hair topped by an elaborate headpiece or helmet decorated with feathers. The figure wears a draped garment with folds and patterns. On the right side, there is another bearded male head in profile. The backdrop is a blend of shades and strokes, creating a sense of depth without discernible details, giving an ancient or mythological atmosphere. The drawing is monochrome, emphasizing texture through shading and highlighting facial features and attire details.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person's upper body, from the mid-torso upwards. The person is facing forward with a slight turn to their right, looking at the viewer. They have curly, light-colored hair framing their face. The person has delicate facial features with a fair complexion, gentle eyes, and a subtle smile. They are wearing a high-collared garment with frills and small buttons, possibly part of formal attire, and a necklace with circular beads around their neck. The background is a plain, muted color with a soft gradient, emphasizing the subject without any distinct objects or patterns.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Christ in the Desert
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome drawing of two figures. One figure is seated in the foreground, while the other is standing or leaning slightly forward in the background. The seated figure has long hair and a beard, wearing flowing robes. The standing figure also has long hair and a beard, wearing a robe. A textured tree trunk and branches are visible in the background. The drawing has a sketch-like quality with shading for depth. The background is sparse, with the focus on the two figures.

artworks.title: The Marriage at Cana
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 36.3 × 44.1 cm (14 5/16 × 17 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large banquet scene in an architectural setting. The image portrays numerous individuals seated around a long table, engaged in a gathering. It takes place in a grand hall with a richly decorated ceiling featuring beams and chandeliers. There are open doorways and arches in the background leading to other areas where additional figures can be seen. Large vessels are prominently positioned at the lower part of the image, with figures engaged in pouring liquids or participating in the event. The setting appears to be an inn or a dining hall, as barrels are seen in another part of the building. The intricate details of the clothing and the architecture suggest a Renaissance or Baroque influence.

artworks.title: Armand Guéraud
artworks.medium: etching and engraving in black and red on laid paper [printed from 2 plates]
artworks.description: The image shows a man's bust, with the upper half of his body visible in a formal pose. He has a full beard and mustache, with curly or wavy, receding hair. The man is wearing a suit with a high collared shirt and a bow tie. Around him are books and scrolls with various titles visible, such as "CODE" and "LOIS." The background features a library or study with shelves full of books and writing implements.

artworks.title: Figures in Rowing Boats in a Rocky Cove, Sailing Ships Beyond
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laidpaper
artworks.description: The image shows a serene landscape painted with delicate brushstrokes. A rocky formation with trees sits on the left, with a horizon of distant mountains in the background. The sky is filled with large cloud formations, reflecting in the water. A small boat with rowers and a larger sail ship are visible on the water. The color palette is predominantly sepia tones, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Stanislaw Sobocki (?)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing confidently on a raised platform. He has one hand on his hip and the other hand holding a sword. He has sharp facial features, a mustache, and styled hair. He is wearing elaborate Renaissance-style clothing with a ruff around his neck, a patterned doublet with puffed sleeves, puffy breeches, and a sash over his shoulder. There is no visible jewelry. The background depicts a town, rolling hills, and armies in formation, suggesting a historical scene. An emblem with a coat of arms is visible in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Hadleigh Castle (Large Plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The scene includes two cylindrical towers, ruins of walls, a tree, a figure with a dog walking, a dramatic sky with swirling clouds, and distant ships on the water. The color palette consists of various shades of gray with soft transitions from light to shadow.

artworks.title: Birth of Adonis
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. Trees cover most of the view, with birds visible on the horizon. The brushstrokes are meticulous, emphasizing detail in the trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with brown and gray tones. A path leads into the forest, where figures are gathered. The sky is visible at the top with wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Venus Abducting Adonis
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woodland scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is visible in the far distance where the trees meet the sky. In the foreground, there are figures and a small cart being drawn by a river or path to the left. To the right, several figures are reclining beneath large, leafy trees. The trees are depicted with cross-hatching for texture, and the engraving lines give the scene depth. The color palette is monochrome, created by the engraving technique. The sky above is textured with a few clouds. In the distance, hints of rocky outcrops or hills are visible.

artworks.title: Venus Offering Diana a Choice between Cupid and Adonis
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a group of figures on a path surrounded by natural scenery. The horizon features distant mountain peaks and trees. The landscape is stylized with detailed brushwork, creating texture in the foliage and terrain. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia. In the foreground, there is a rock, grass, and trees framing the central group of figures. The figures are interacting with each other, some holding staffs or spears, surrounded by dense trees.

artworks.title: Venus and Adonis Hunting
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is set high with distant mountains. There are clouds in the sky and a flock of birds flying in formation. The engravings feature detailed line work capturing textures of trees, ground, and sky. Two human figures and dogs are on the right near water. The color palette is monochrome with gradients in black and white. Trees frame the left side of the image, contrasting with the open middle and distant areas.

artworks.title: Death of Adonis
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills transitioning into a distant mountain range. A tree with a thick trunk and spreading branches is central in the composition. Close to us, there is a wild boar and hunting dogs depicted with intricate etching. The style features precise linework capturing textures, with a monochromatic color palette of brown and sepia. Trees and foliage fill the scene, creating texture across the image.
